name: Clifford Ressel
bio: Clifford Ressel is the co-founder and CTO of Nori Agentic, a company that provides cloud infrastructure for teams running AI agents to develop software and automate operational work. He works on the future of coding agents, including nori-cli, a Rust-based CLI for running coding agents across models and providers, and nori-skillsets for portable, reusable agent skills. He studied computer science and linguistics at Carnegie Mellon University.
